card.name: The word tablets after a drug name
card.fires_on: The word "tablets" (or its start, "TABLE" in "TABLETS") right after a named drug in label text. It is the product name used as the subject, as in "ibuprofen tablets are administered".

modes.label: Drug name plus tablets
modes.description: "tablets" follows a single drug name or a combination of drug names as the subject of a warning or interaction sentence.
modes.example: of additional CNS depressants including alcohol and illicit drugs. Neonatal Opioid Withdrawal Syndrome Use of oxycodone and acetaminophen<< tablets>> for an extended period of time during pregnancy

modes.label: Capitalised heading form
modes.description: The word is split inside an all-caps drug title, with "TABLE" before "TS".
modes.example: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING RISKS FROM USE OF TRAMADOL HYDROCHLORIDE EXTENDED-RELEASE<< TABLE>>TS Addiction, Abuse, and Misuse
